intro.text: A bay north of Alethkar, bordering the Sadeas, Aladar and Roion princedoms. It separates Alethkar from Akak, a Reshi island, and from the northwestern peninsula of Herdaz, and opens into the Steamwater Ocean.

description.text: In the Heraldic Epochs the bay touched both Rishir and Alethela.
The Alethi port of Dalilak stands on its shore.
